intro: Sageuks, Korea's historical dramas, take viewers to dynasties such as Joseon and Goryeo, with elaborate costumes, political intrigue and epic romances that hold you from the first episode to the last.
HallyuHub organizes the best sageuk in its catalog so you can find where to watch, meet the cast and explore the stories that shaped Korea.

faq.question: What is sageuk?
faq.answer: Sageuk is the Korean term for historical drama. These dramas are set in periods such as the Joseon Dynasty (1392–1897) or Goryeo, and combine history, politics, romance and, at times, fantasy.

faq.question: Which sageuk are the best known?
faq.answer: "Mr. Sunshine", "Jewel in the Palace", "Six Flying Dragons" and "Kingdom" are among the most acclaimed. "Kingdom", on Netflix, brought the genre to an international audience.

doramas-romanticos.title: Korean Romance Dramas
doramas-romanticos.description: Discover the best Korean romance dramas, with synopsis, cast, ratings and where to watch.
intro: Korean romances shaped a genre of their own: unforgettable OSTs, chemistry between the leads and stories that balance drama and lightness in an unusual way.
This guide gathers the Korean romance productions cataloged on HallyuHub, with pages in English to help you understand the cast, the synopsis and where to watch.
doramas-romanticos.whatYouWillFind: Here you will find Korean romance dramas cataloged on HallyuHub, with synopsis in English, ratings, cast and information on where to watch, from big Netflix hits to classics from the Korean broadcasters.

faq.question: What makes a good Korean romance drama?
faq.answer: A good Korean romance drama combines chemistry between the leads, a memorable OST, well-developed emotional conflicts and the famous slow tension before the couple gets together.

faq.question: What is "slow burn" in romance dramas?
faq.answer: Slow burn is romantic tension that builds gradually over the episodes, with the couple resisting their feelings before giving in. It is one of the most loved traits of K-dramas and keeps viewers coming back across a whole series.

faq.question: Do romance dramas have happy endings?
faq.answer: Most Korean romance dramas end happily. There are acclaimed exceptions with more open or melancholic endings, such as "My Mister" and "Nevertheless".

faq.question: Are there shorter romance dramas for beginners?
faq.answer: Yes. Dramas such as "Business Proposal" (12 episodes), "Nevertheless" (10 episodes) and "What's Wrong with Secretary Kim" (16 episodes) are good ways in, since they are shorter and lighter.

intro: In Korean crime dramas, the case of the week shares the stage with what an investigation demands of the people running it: teams of detectives, prosecutors and reporters split the lead, and corruption inside the institution weighs as much as the crime itself. Signal (tvN, 2016), in which a radio links detectives from two eras, is one of the most cited titles of the format.

There are two rhythms: series that close a case per episode and series that follow a single case across the whole season. The list below follows recent interest, with the best-rated titles highlighted.
doramas-policiais-coreanos.whatYouWillFind: Stories of investigation, crime, police stations, prosecutors, detectives and criminal suspense, with links to related productions and artists.

faq.question: What is the difference between a crime drama and a thriller?
faq.answer: A crime drama is built around the investigation: police stations, detectives, prosecutors and the case to be solved. A thriller can do without the police and rely on tension and threat; the two often blend.

faq.question: Do crime dramas have a case per episode?
faq.answer: Some close a case per episode; others follow a single case through the whole season. Many combine both, with a larger case in the background.

faq.question: Where should I start?
faq.answer: Signal (tvN, 2016), which is in the catalog, is a common starting point: it mixes cold cases, travel between eras and team investigation.

faq.answer: A mystery drama has at its center a secret, riddle or crime that must be solved over the course of the story. It can mix romance, horror or thriller into the main plot.

doramas-viki.title: Korean Dramas on Viki
doramas-viki.description: Find Korean dramas available on Viki, with synopsis, cast, ratings and related pages in English.
intro: Viki is one of the platforms best known to K-Drama fans, with a strong catalog of romances, historical dramas, romantic comedies and classic series that do not always appear on general streaming services.
This guide gathers the Korean productions associated with Viki cataloged on HallyuHub to make it easier to discover cast, synopsis, ratings and related content.

faq.question: Does Viki have subtitled Korean dramas?
faq.answer: Yes. Viki is known for its catalog of Asian dramas with subtitles in many languages.
